title: [Sponsor] WorkOS AuthKit: Auth for Your App, Free Up to 1M Monthly Active Users
content:
Login looks simple until you’re building password resets, email verification, MFA, social providers, session management, and the enterprise SSO your first big customer asked for last week.

AuthKit lets you:

  • Offer SSO, MFA, passkeys, passwords, email codes, and social sign-in
  • Add and remove users automatically with SCIM provisioning
  • Track who did what with audit logs
